text_block_list.text: After finishing my business, I was about to leave the studio, but caught sight of Yukino Bijin practicing her dance lessons.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I wanna bust out some super cool moves
at the Winning Live too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: You were trying so hard, it was adorable.
You were trying so hard, it was adorable.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
B-But compared to the other girls...
Didn't I seem, well... kind of plain?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~. What should I do to put on a kickass concert
like all the other girls, I wonder?!
choice_data_list: How about incorporating some intense steps?
How about trying some acrobatic moves?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it~!
You're right, my dance was missin' that raw punch...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: Looks like we need more training.
Looks like you need more training.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hahaha.
It's still really tricky, isn't it~

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Acrobatic... like a backflip, maybe?!
Though, that feels like a pretty high bar...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No way! If I wanna get closer to bein' a true 'City Girl,'
I've gotta at least be able to handle this much, right?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: That was quite a spectacular fall.
That was quite a spectacular fall.

text_block_list.text:
I couldn't understand her dialect,
but it was crystal clear that she was embarrassed.
